## Code Review

This pull request introduces two new integration test files: `continuation_diagnostics.rs` in `core/tests` and `continuation_diagnostics.rs` in `ext/goal/tests`. The feedback highlights two issues in the newly added goal extension test: first, the test is currently vacuous because it fails to invoke `on_turn_error` on the lifecycle contributors, meaning the error is never actually observed; second, using `tempdir.keep()` prevents the temporary directory from being cleaned up, leaking files on disk, which can be resolved by using `tempdir.path().abs()` instead.
